messages:
Iris: idea: 3-panel "postcard" email that teases benchmark story + webinar invite. keep it short.

Ben: love it. hero: 'Predictable latency, predictable spend' (under 40 chars).

Tam: charts: 1) scatter: cost per 1k tokens vs median latency (hosted vs dedicated) 2) small gif showing batching reduces tokens for many short prompts 3) p99 tail before/after caching. captions one line each.

Sofia: routing: clicks-> if corporate email show "Book demo", else "Try sandbox". capture company size. UTMs: bench_postcard_v1.

Iris: copy snippets: opening question, 3 bullets (what we measured, percent savings, tail impact), CTA buttons. keep legal-safe language.

Ben: need eng CSV for numbers + quantized run. can eng provide by Tue?

Tam: will ping eng. include hosted/dedicated/4-bit rows.

Sofia: webinar: 25 min (15 demo, 10 Q&A), cohost Eng + Product. registration form fields listed in campaign doc.

marketing-bot: Campaign draft saved (id: camp_7629). Drive: https://drive.redwood/bench-7629.

Iris: timeline: draft by Mon, design Wed, test Fri, send next Tue. tagging @Tam for eng numbers. :rocket:
